title: Instacart Sans
slide_intent: Show how one product face can change weight while preserving a recognizable letter structure. That continuity helps people identify actions across an interface.
strategic_value: A variable Sans can give Instacart practical product copy several levels of emphasis.
demonstration: Four rows repeat the same word at progressively heavier weights and pair each with an alphabet and numeral sample. The introduction identifies optical sizes for the product interface.
practical_value: Compare the word and its character set in the same row when selecting a weight for product copy.

content_islands.spec: Keep the title above a narrow statement about the interface role and optical sizes.

content_islands.spec: Set four large repetitions in a middle column. Align the matching smaller character sets at right so changes in weight can be compared row by row.
